em_level_reasoning: ESTABLISHED PATIENT post-operative follow-up day 14 after CPT 28285 (left 2nd digit PIP arthroplasty for hammertoe). CPT 28285 carries a 90-day global surgical period; this visit (day 14) falls within the global period and is for a reason related to the original procedure (incision check, K-wire monitoring, routine post-op wound care). Per CMS rules, post-op visits within the global period are not separately billable as E/M and are reported with 99024 (no charge). The post-op X-ray (73620-LT) is separately billable as it is not bundled into the surgical global package. Modifier -25 not applicable as 99024 is a non-billable tracking code. No procedures performed today; no modifier -57 needed.
